description: Creates a new budget plan. The version is incremented automatically for plans with the same name and year. A plan with type=forecast holds the ACTUAL values of the already closed months plus the forecast for the remaining months of the year; otherwise year and YTD comparisons against actuals are wrong. The closed months can be read via get_periodic_summaries (category_totals) and are loaded together with the forecast via upload-budget-entries as category entries.

organization_id.description: ID of the organization this call runs in (from list_organizations). Required for tools that change data when you belong to more than one organization. Read tools use the active organization when omitted. Does not change the active organization.

name: create-budget-plan
